cfb:26OCT09FSULOU.summary: Florida State arrives with eighteen players already ruled out, including its lead running back, a top receiver, three defensive backs and three linebackers. Louisville has lost every game by three points this year and its quarterback is probable after an ankle injury.

picks.reason: Baker Mayfield is officially out and undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels makes his second straight start, with top safety Antoine Winfield Jr. also out, per the Bucs' final injury report on Yahoo Sports and Bucs Nation. ESPN and VegasInsider show Dallas favored by about ten points now after opening as a small favorite, so winning by eight should be a little more likely than this Kalshi price suggests.

picks.label: Tyson Bagent under 2 passing TDs

Bagent has not thrown a single touchdown pass in his six games this year and Chicago leaned on the run game to win last week, so two touchdown passes from him would be a surprise.

picks.label: Tyler Goodson under 20 rushing yards
picks.reason: Tyler Goodson is Dallas's third running back behind Javonte Williams and has averaged only a handful of rushing yards a game over his last thirteen (slate data). Even if Dallas runs out the clock late, he rarely gets enough carries to reach twenty yards.

picks.label: Under 46.5 points
picks.reason: Ja'Marr Chase did not practice Wednesday and is still in the concussion protocol per ESPN's Ben Baby, and Tee Higgins is day-to-day with a groin issue per Field Level Media. Miami is winless with new starter Malik Willis and the sportsbooks have this game expected to land in the low forties, so fewer than 47 total points is a comfortable spot even though unders have been poor for the tool lately.

picks.label: Texas win by 8+
picks.reason: Texas is the top-ranked team and the sportsbooks favor them by about nine or ten at the Cotton Bowl, per SI and Covers, while Oklahoma has scored two touchdowns or fewer in three straight games and sits last in its league in offensive efficiency. ESPN's model, our own ratings and Covers' projected score all have Texas winning by double digits.

picks.label: Kyler Murray under 2 passing TDs
picks.reason: Kyler Murray has averaged less than one touchdown pass a game in his eight games for Minnesota (slate data), and Justin Jefferson is still day-to-day with his ankle with Jordan Addison also questionable, per Newsweek and the Vikings' own report. Minnesota has been winning low-scoring games with its defense and ground game, so one or zero touchdown passes is the likeliest outcome.

picks.label: Cowboys win by 8+ + Under 46.5 points
picks.reason: Two games where a backup or struggling quarterback is on the wrong side: Tampa Bay's rookie against Dallas, and Miami's Malik Willis against a Bengals team that may be without Ja'Marr Chase. Both legs have the sportsbooks already leaning further our way than the Kalshi prices.
